lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap for Fiji through the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API. The dataset represents approximately 97% of total buildings based on AI-mapped estimates, with an average data age of 4 years and minimal recent updates (0% in last 6 months). Data is provided in multiple geospatial formats (KML, GeoJSON, Shapefile, GeoPackage) with structural attributes including building type, levels, materials, and address information.
